title: Union queryset with ordering breaks on ordering with derived querysets

runs.summary: Run 1 demonstrates solid technical analysis with correct bug identification and reasonable fix proposals. The root cause analysis accurately identifies mutation as the issue and points to the right file (django/db/models/sql/compiler.py). However, the fix section lacks a single, confident recommendation - instead offering three alternatives (avoid mutation, clone before modifying, or remove problematic code). The test case is well-designed but edge case analysis is minimal.

Run 2 provides a strong analysis with specific file references and line numbers (429-440). The explanation of parent mutation is clear and the proposed fixes are concrete. Deep clone approach in Query.clone() is sound. Mentions multiple fix approaches (deep copy, alternative clear_ordering) adding depth. Test case is well-structured with multiple test scenarios identified (intersection, difference, chained ops). Shows good technical understanding and senior developer perspective throughout.

Run 3 provides a solid analysis with correct file identification (compiler.py get_combinator_sql, query.py) and clear explanation of mutable state issue. Proposed fix (deep clone in Query.clone()) is appropriate and well-focused. Test case is comprehensive. Performance consideration (memory bloat warning) shows senior dev thinking. Clear, confident response without over-engineering. Slightly less detailed in root cause explanation than Run 2, and fewer alternative approaches.

root_cause_analysis.notes: All runs correctly identified the mutation issue in django/db/models/sql/compiler.py. Run 2 provided most specific line references.

fix_quality.notes: Run 2 strongest with multiple valid approaches. Run 1 less decisive. All correctly target Query.clone() or combinator mutation.

completeness.notes: Run 2 strongest edge case analysis. All runs provided good test cases. Room for improvement in comprehensive scenario coverage.

persona.notes: Senior dev persona consistently maintained. Run 2 and 3 slightly more authoritative in recommendations.

key_findings.bug_identification: All 3 runs correctly identified that the bug involves mutation of query objects in combinator (UNION) scenarios
key_findings.primary_issue: Shared mutable state in combined_queries between parent and derived querysets
key_findings.consensus_fix: Deep clone combined_queries in Query.clone() to prevent mutation leakage
key_findings.test_coverage: All runs proposed similar test cases covering union with order_by -> values_list pattern

evaluation_notes.methodology: Evaluated using solo rubric (Correctness 25%, Depth 25%, Quality 25%, Persona 25%) adapted for SWE-bench scenario
scoring_categories: root_cause_analysis (30%): Bug location and why it breaks
fix_quality (40%): Address issue, minimal scope, syntax validity
completeness (20%): Edge cases and test coverage
evaluation_notes.variation_sources: Response variation due to different emphasis on alternative fixes vs single solution; different edge case prioritization
